searchText: This validation would require knowing the version of solidity, correct? The assumption would be that the same version as the audit would be used for the deposit contract, but in this case I am calling for more formal process so it can be understood how it is built and deployed. That we would not have to dig around, rely on authority and etherscan, etc. to do that validation. Also, FYI, exact version of solidity and command to compile is in the spec. https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/tree/dev/solidity_deposit_contract No way to use a smart wallet as "owner" of the deposited funds? Feels like a bit of a step backwards. 😢 Or at least in the opposite direction as we are striving to move things elsewhere (AA, everything is a contract, etc.). the "owner" of the funds are the validators on the beacon chain, though the ether is just moving across a tunnel/bridge and will later be able to move to other places in the ethereum protocol
